newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico orange growers to ship 1,200 T to Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Mexico orange growers to ship 1,200 T to Argentina.

text.p: Orange farmers from the northern state of Nuevo Leon won contracts to ship 1,200 tonnes of fruit to Argentina, the Montemorelos Citrus Association said.
"Argentines came last week to check the fruit...and there is no problem and it is going to be shipped," Jesus Davalos Chavarria, the association president said.

Montemorelos, alongside General Teran, Linares, Allende and Hualahuises, are predominantly citrus orientated zones in Nuevo Leon, producing around 10 percent of the national crop estimated to average 2.5 million tonnes.
Davalos said the exports, won by Empacadora Mexico company based in Montemorelos, will be shipped in 60 containers out of the port of Altamira, Tamaulipas, in six weeks' time.
